# Straight to Georgia

> Independent guide and student advisory for international students who want to study in English in Georgia (Tbilisi, Batumi, Kutaisi). Compares 30 universities and 195 English-taught programs with tuition, duration and admission information, and helps students with applications, documents and arrival. Tuition figures were checked in October 2026 and must be confirmed with each university.

## Key pages
- [Top universities in Georgia for international students](https://straighttogeorgia.com/universities/): all universities with programs and fees
- [English-taught programs in Georgia](https://straighttogeorgia.com/programs/): by field and by degree level
- [Guides for international students in Georgia](https://straighttogeorgia.com/guides/): visa and residence permit, application roadmap, tuition fees, checklist

## Notes
- Prices are annual tuition in US dollars (EUR/GEL fees are converted at approximate rates).
- Admission decisions are made by universities and visas by the authorities; Straight to Georgia provides guidance, not guarantees.
